landing.meta_description: CiteAura is the Generative Engine Optimization platform for evidence-based AI visibility work. Set up a domain, audit citations across major models, generate engineering tickets, run verification, and export delivery packs.
landing.title: CiteAura | Win Brand Visibility in the AI Search Era — Next-Gen GEO Platform
landing.hero_copy: Enter a domain to audit citations across ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. Turn audits into 13 actionable engineering tickets, close knowledge gaps, and measure verifiable visibility growth.
landing.hero_title: Win brand visibility in the AI search era.
landing.truth_title: Zero guesswork. Measure real AI visibility with rigorous data boundaries.
landing.truth_body: AI outputs vary by knowledge source. CiteAura strictly distinguishes between parametric model memory, web-grounded retrieval, and product-surface interaction. Unmeasured engines are reported honestly—empowering marketing teams with verifiable, multi-period trendlines.
landing.truth_engines_dd: Unified measurement across DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, GLM, and more with exact prompt tracing.
landing.truth_sampling_dd: Combine automated API sampling with manual product-surface checks in a single unified dashboard.
landing.truth_principle_dd: Unmeasured engines are never masked as 0%; every citation is grounded in reproducible prompts.
landing.workflow_title: From domain to verifiable delivery in 5 closed-loop steps
landing.workflow_body: Unify AI diagnosis, strategy, engineering tickets, verification runs, and client delivery into one standard pipeline.
landing.workflow_1_body: Crawl core site content, automatically map brand facts, competitor matrices, and target question sets.
landing.workflow_2_body: Inspect crawlability, structural semantics, extraction blocks, and authority signals across model matrices.
landing.workflow_3_body: Convert diagnosis into 13 standardized engineering tickets prioritized by Impact × Effort with clear acceptance criteria.
landing.workflow_4_body: Re-crawl deployed pages, compare AI sampling, and run verification explicitly when you are ready to evaluate progress.
landing.workflow_5_body: Generate executive audit decks, action matrices, ticket logs, comparisons, and assets with explicit readiness checks.
landing.product_title: Actionable evidence and engineering next steps on one unified screen.
landing.product_body: Every visibility score links directly to page-level gaps; every gap maps to engineering tickets and verification history.

landing.pricing_title: Choose the AI visibility plan that fits your growth
landing.pricing_body: Transparent pricing with no hidden token markups. Every plan includes full audit loops, tickets, and deliverables.
landing.plan_starter_summary: Ideal for indie makers & single brands
landing.plan_pro_summary: Continuous multi-model tracking for growth brands
landing.plan_agency_summary: Parallel client delivery for digital agencies

landing.plan_agency_3: Team multi-role permissions & white-label delivery branding
landing.plan_ent_3: Custom data retention & dedicated support team
landing.pricing_note: No guarantee of mention or ranking. AI answers are noisy; trends need multiple sampling rounds.
landing.faq_1_q: Do API samples match what users see in the product UI?
landing.faq_1_a: Most APIs measure parametric model knowledge, not live product search. CiteAura clearly labels each engine as API · Model knowledge, API · Web-grounded retrieval, or Manual · Product surface for complete scientific integrity.
landing.faq_2_q: Must I bring my own model API keys (BYOK)?
landing.faq_2_a: BYOK is the most secure and cost-effective method. You only configure the engines you intend to use; others are honestly shown as unmeasured. Model APIs are extremely affordable (single audits typically cost ~$0.08–$0.15) with zero middleman markup.
landing.faq_3_q: Can CiteAura guarantee my brand will be ranked or mentioned by AI?
landing.faq_3_a: No. Any vendor promising guaranteed AI recommendations is untruthful. CiteAura provides rigorous diagnosis, standardized engineering tickets, and repeatable verification evidence to help teams improve visibility over time.
landing.faq_4_q: What is included in the 14-day free trial?
landing.faq_4_a: The 14-day free trial includes the trial workspace allocation: 3 projects, 2 sample runs per project, full reports, action tickets, and delivery packages with no credit card required.
landing.faq_5_q: Is CiteAura suitable for digital marketing agencies delivering to clients?
landing.faq_5_a: Absolutely. The Agency plan is tailored for agencies with 30 active projects, team role permissions, white-label client headers, and downloadable client-ready delivery packs.
